images.notes: Retaken in Unity 7000.0.0a20 (trunk build of 2026-11-18) at 2x: one real floating Profiler window (697pt, the original's width) showing a Play mode recording of the Atrio scene, captured twice from the same frames, with the Editor's colour-blind condition set to Default and to Deuteranopia (Preferences > Accessibility, the setting behind the Profiler's Color Blind Mode). images.alt_text: A Console window with labeled elements showing different text colors.
images.notes: Retaken in Unity 7000.0.0a20 (trunk build of 2026-11-17) at 2x: a real floating Console (670x322pt, timestamps on, collapse off, first entry selected) above the main window's status bar. The detail pane is sized to end on the link line because the next frame shows a local source path. Log entries use small icons, and there is no blank line between the message and the trace.
